# Draftava 1.3.4
- Redesigns Draft group headers for clearer hierarchy, stronger contrast, and a larger expand/collapse click target. - Improves Draft group reordering so release handoff matches Draft-row behavior and removes the extra post-drop settling motion and artificial group gap. - Adds Move to Top and Move to Bottom actions to the Idea Shelf context menu. - Fixes an intermittent Idea Shelf scrollbar-thumb artifact during SwiftUI layout updates.
